title: Distance
author: Zachary Nadel
description: In Distance, you are navigating through a Long Distance Relationship (LDR). In this game, you take on the role of the main character as you deal with the ups and downs of a modern LDR. You view the relationship of the characters through the scope of their phone, never leaving the screen throughout the game. A full play-through is estimated to take between 1:00 and 1:30 depending on the reader's speed.
